key.name: bindings
key.description: For example "<Control>F9=spotify.desktop". The accelerator uses the GTK syntax (as in Settings, e.g. <Shift><Super>XF86TouchpadOff); the desktop id is the file name of the app's .desktop file. The first entry for a key wins.

key.name: show-desktop-shortcut
key.description: Off by default. Fades and minimizes visible windows on this workspace; press again to restore them. Native three-finger gestures stay with GNOME.

key.name: show-desktop-grab-status
key.summary: Last Show desktop grab result reported by GNOME Shell
key.description: Internal status written by Focus Keys, followed by the shortcuts checked. Preferences only display this result; it is not a user preference.

key.name: cycle-windows
key.description: When the app already has the focus, pressing its shortcut again moves to its next window.
